atAGlance: Nước ép chanh dây turns passion fruit into a bright Vietnamese café drink, tangy, floral, aromatic, and vivid over ice.
whatItIs: Nước ép chanh dây is passion fruit mixed with water, sugar, and ice. Expect passion fruit juice that is tangy, floral, aromatic, and bright yellow-orange.
howToEnjoy: Ask for less sugar only if you enjoy strong tartness.
howLocalsOrder: Nước ép chanh dây is usually made or poured cold, so ask no sugar, less sugar, or no ice before the glass is finished. Fresh fruit versions taste best when the flavor stays tart, pulpy, or fragrant.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Nước ép chanh dây is a vivid tropical drink that shows Vietnam’s love of sweet-sour refreshment.
goodToKnow: Seeds or pulp may be included.
